name: SPARSEUP (Linkup sparse retriever)

lineage.how_derived: SPLADE-style learned sparse retriever: MLM head grafted on, contrastive fine-tuning on the DenseOn/LateOn recipe data (card)

purpose: Fills the missing sparse slot beside LightOn's DenseOn (single-vector) and LateOn (late interaction) so the three architectures can be compared with backbone and data fixed (card).
